note: Catalogue capture uplifted to the held tier-2 BTR-4 operation manual (В1318Е РЭ, 2010). Section 3 publishes the full mass, the overall length, the hull width, the height, the wheelbase, the track, the road clearance, the road speed, the range, the climb and side-slope limits, the 3TD-3A engine with its bench-test power and torque, the hydromechanical automatic gearbox with five forward ratios and the 12.00R20 or 365/80R20 tyres. Every value moves to grade documented. The manual publishes no net power with a stated basis, so net_power_kw stays a derived figure. The manual covers the BTR-4E export configuration; the figures recorded name that variant.
